# Tools

Generated from the tool table (`src/core/api/tools.ts`). Every call returns `{ok, data, warnings, errors}`. Without MCP, call a tool with `scaffold --json call <tool> --input '<json>'`.

## `doctor` (read-only)

Checks the vault, event log, config, concept graph, CSS snippet and Anki (AnkiConnect version, FSRS, deck structure, budgets, queue). Each failure has one next step.

No input.

## `get_briefing` (read-only)

At most 600 tokens: resolved focus and why, recap of the last session on that subject, due KCs, misconceptions, frontier, plan, other subjects, Anki load, warnings (LM-11). focus: a subject name/alias or "all".

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `focus` | string \| null |  |  |
| `minutes` | number |  |  |
| `carryover` | integer |  |  |

## `plan_session`

Deterministic plan that fits `minutes` (LM-10). During an open session it is logged as a replan; call it again when the learner changes the focus subject or the time (TP-09).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `focus` | string \| null |  |  |
| `minutes` | number |  |  |
| `carryover` | integer |  |  |

## `start_session`

Start here (D3.3). Pass the subject the learner named, if any. Resolves the focus (LM-15), records it with the plan, and returns the briefing. unknown_subject → offer onboarding (D3.10); subject_not_active → offer to reopen (ANK-07).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `focus` | string \| null |  |  |
| `minutes` | number |  |  |
| `carryover` | integer |  |  |

## `end_session`

Close every session (TP-15): after the exit ticket, with a summary, open threads and a one-line preview of next time. Writes the session log and returns the calibration line (D3.9).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | string |  |  |
| `summary` | string | yes |  |
| `open_threads` | string[] |  |  |
| `next_preview` | string | yes |  |

## `upsert_subject`

Creates a subject (scope active, title, aliases) and its Anki deck Scaffold::<title> (LM-14, ANK-01). Derived fields are rejected. Scope changes go through set_subject_scope.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string |  | Stable slug; derived from the title if omitted. |
| `title` | string | yes |  |
| `aliases` | string[] |  |  |
| `goals` | string[] |  |  |
| `scope` | "active" \| "paused" \| "closed" |  | Only at creation; later use set_subject_scope. |
| `anki_minutes` | "auto" \| number |  |  |
| `anki_deck` | string |  |  |

## `list_subjects` (read-only)

Subjects with ids, titles, aliases, scope, KC and due counts. Use it to map the learner’s loose phrasing to a subject.

No input.

## `get_concept` (read-only)

One KC: fields, status, mastery, memory, misconceptions, recent attempts, question ids and (optionally) its note text.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kc_id` | string | yes |  |
| `include_text` | boolean |  |  |

## `upsert_concept`

Saves KCs (one or a batch, e.g. an approved onboarding map). Derived fields are rejected; prerequisites must form a DAG (LM-12). Explanation text is written only into empty sections.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `concepts` | {id, title, subject, kind, prerequisites, confusable_with, requires_visual, volatility, review_by, sources, explanation, worked_example}[] | yes |  |

## `review_question`

Cross-model review (QB-04): without verdict returns the question and QB-01 checklist (refused during a session); with verdict ok|fix|reject records it. The reviewer must be the other model family.

| `question_id` | string | yes |  |
| `verdict` | "ok" \| "fix" \| "reject" |  |  |
| `by` | string |  |  |
| `notes` | string |  |  |

## `validate` (read-only)

Checks the concept DAG, notes, questions and the event log.

No input.

## `anki_sync`

Syncs with AnkiConnect (ANK-08): replays queued operations once each, creates note types and subject decks, pulls cards and reviews (lapses, leeches), flags stale cards and proposes budget actions. Offline: reports the queue (ANK-09).

No input.

## `get_anki_load` (read-only)

Per subject and in total: measured (7-day) and estimated Anki minutes per day against budgets, active cards, yearly intake, recommended deck limits (ANK-01, ANK-06).

No input.

## `propose_cards`

Proposes cards for KCs retrieved correctly this session (TP-14), each with one-line answers to the three admission tests (ANK-03). Rejects violations of the caps (3 per KC, one anchor) and of the yearly intake budget. Nothing is added until apply_card_actions.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | string |  |  |
| `cards` | {kc_id, note_type, front, back, extra, anchor, admission}[] | yes |  |
| `by` | string |  |  |

## `propose_card_actions`

Proposes rewrite, rewrite_reset, retire, dormant, unsuspend, pause_new, unpause_new, compress or keep for existing cards (ANK-04). Applied only after the learner approves.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actions` | {kind, note_ids, subject, reason, fields, retire_reason}[] | yes |  |
| `by` | string |  |  |

## `apply_card_actions`

Only after the learner explicitly approves (TP-17): pass the action ids and their words. Adds, rewrites (resetting a card whose answer changed), suspends and tags; never deletes. A card edited in Anki since the proposal is not overwritten (ANK-08).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action_ids` | string[] | yes |  |
| `approval` | {learner_quote} | yes |  |
| `edits` | object |  |  |

## `list_card_actions` (read-only)

Card proposals and changes waiting for approval (or all, with pending_only false).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pending_only` | boolean |  |  |

active | paused | closed (ANK-07). Pausing or closing proposes dormancy for non-anchor, unprotected cards; reopening proposes unsuspension and marks the KCs needs_check.

## `register_visual`

Persist a visual you showed (TP-12, VIS-03): SVG or HTML source (or a plot spec that Scaffold computes), KC links, purpose, what to notice, alt text and generator code for plots. Runs the fast static checks (well-formed, title/desc or aria-label, size limit, no network references, fonts ≥ 11 px). A failing visual gets one fix attempt: re-register with the returned visual_id; then it is kept with warnings or dropped (ARC-10).

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kc_ids` | string[] | yes |  |
| `kind` | "diagram" \| "stepper" \| "mechanism" \| "plot" \| "widget" \| "comparison" \| "dashboard" | yes |  |
| `title` | string | yes |  |
| `format` | "svg" \| "html" |  | Required with source; plot implies svg. |
| `source` | string |  | SVG markup or HTML (a fragment is wrapped in a self-contained page with the theme shim). |
| `plot` | {title, desc, x, y, params, series, samples, height} |  | Instead of source: a plot spec; Scaffold computes every curve and stores the spec as the generator. |
| `purpose` | string | yes |  |
| `notice` | string | yes | What to notice, naming the labelled parts (A, B, ①). |
| `alt` | string | yes |  |
| `generator_code` | string |  | Code that computed the curves (plots). |
| `provenance` | string |  |  |
| `visual_id` | string |  | The id from a needs_fix result (the one fix attempt), or to update. |
| `session_id` | string \| null |  |  |

## `check_visual` (read-only)

Static checks on a stored visual plus the last render check (light/dark, overlaps, overflow, fonts), which the owner runs with `scaffold visual check`.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `visual_id` | string | yes |  |

## `get_visual` (read-only)

Returns a stored visual’s source, purpose, what to notice, alt text and generator, to re-display it or quiz with it ("In V-0012, what does … at ①?").

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `visual_id` | string | yes |  |
